title: Upper ME: Press

jumps: DB Bench Press 3 · 5-sec lower @ RPE 8 → Plyometric Push-Up 5 → Med Ball Chest Pass 5 → Medicine Ball Slams 5
Eccentric wk 2: heavier, 5 sec down · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
note: Eccentric wk 2: heavier than last week, 5-second lowering.
